title: National Army Museum: 1914 - To arms

title: US National Archives: World War I Centennial
notes: American participation and associated archival material.

title: UK History of Government: The war that did not end at 11am on 11 November

notes: Confirms signature on 28 June 1919 and ceremony location.

title: Australian founding documents: Treaty of Versailles extract
